Container.Name: rackstack-server
Container.Overview: RackStack self-hosted server. Persists save data to a local SQLite database and requires a stable JWT_SECRET for logins to survive updates - do not leave it blank or change it after first run.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI is served on

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database storage - the entire persistent state (users + saves). Do not remove this mapping when updating the container.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. Signs login cookies. Generate once with 'openssl rand -hex 32' and never change it after first run, or all existing users will be logged out.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Discord OAuth client ID. Leave blank to disable Discord login.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL
Config.Description: Must match the redirect URL configured on the Discord OAuth app.

Config.Name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth client ID. Leave blank to disable GitHub login.

Config.Name: GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL
Config.Description: Must match the authorization callback URL configured on the GitHub OAuth app.
